nit: most of these 10 new tests don't add coverage. `conversation_id` is set once in `apply_request_attributes`, before the streaming/non-streaming and success/error paths diverge - so the streaming-create and error tests (x2 files) assert the same line as the basic one. The `{"id": ...}` shape is already covered by the extractor unit test, so the parametrize is redundant too.

Request-param coverage in this file already lives in `test_responses_create_with_all_params` + `_assert_request_attrs`. Suggest following that: add `conversation` there (and to the async twin), keep the `responses.stream()` test since it's a separate `extract_params` call site, and drop the rest.

replies.body: Thanks! Updated as suggested. One other change: since `conversation` only landed in openai 2.0 and this package supports `openai >= 1.26.0`, the parameter is now only passed and asserted when the installed SDK has it.
